summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Fortuna Mining Corp., a foreign private issuer, providing notice of its annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 25, 2026. The filing includes the management information circular, form of proxy, and financial statement request form. The meeting agenda covers standard items: receiving financial statements, appointing auditors, fixing director count at eight, electing directors, and approving unallocated entitlements under the share unit plan. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. This is a routine procedural filing with no market-moving implications.
